# Bundled homepage dependencies

Downloaded September 13, 2026. Versions are unchanged from the previous homepage.

- Bootstrap 3.3.6: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v3.3.6/dist — CSS, JavaScript, source map and all five Glyphicon font formats. MIT license included in `bootstrap/LICENSE`.
- jQuery 1.12.0: https://code.jquery.com/jquery-1.12.0.min.js — license from https://github.com/jquery/jquery/blob/1.12.0/LICENSE.txt included in `jquery/LICENSE.txt`.
- Font Awesome 4.7.0: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/tree/v4.7.0 — CSS and all five referenced font formats. Upstream license notices and links are retained in `font-awesome/README.md` and the CSS header (MIT for code, SIL OFL 1.1 for fonts).
- Philosopher regular and bold: Google Fonts API `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Philosopher:400,700&display=swap`, font files from fonts.gstatic.com version 21. SIL OFL included in `philosopher/OFL.txt`, from https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/philosopher. Local declarations use `font-display: swap`.
- ORCID icon at `../../img/icons/orcid.png`: unchanged 16px icon downloaded from https://orcid.org/sites/default/files/images/orcid_16x16.png.

Oswald was referenced only in a commented-out caption, so its unused stylesheet was removed. External links remain external; loading the homepage itself requires no third-party asset requests.
